title: The Long Afternoon
lessons: belonging can happen without performing it

text: The cooler is somebody else's problem today.
Your towel holds a warm rectangle of sand and no agenda.
The afternoon asks only that you spend it.

choices.text: Walk into the water and float for a while.
Join the loose game happening by the shoreline.

text: For a few minutes, the water carries the whole conversation.
Nobody keeps score for very long.
